title: Leak Sensor Battery Replacement Aging
dataSources: Radon readings (`radon:reading`), sump humidity events (`sump:humidity`), HVAC filter telemetry (`hvacfilter:reading`), and roof leak events (`roofleak:event`).
app: Home health telemetry from radon monitors, sump humidity probes, HVAC filter tracking, and roof leak sensors sent to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=roofleak:event
| search event="battery_change"
| stats latest(_time) as last_seen count as events by sensor_name
| eval days_since=round((now()-last_seen)/86400,1)
| sort - days_since
description: Shows which sensorss have gone quiet for leak-sensor battery replacements.
value: Battery aging matters because a dead leak sensor usually fails silently until the worst possible moment.
implementation: Send leak-sensor battery replacements events to `index=personal` and alert when the gap since the last event grows beyond the expected cadence.
visualization: Table of sensorss with time since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers which sensorss have gone quiet longer than they should for leak-sensor battery replacements.
